name: skiss
description: Your saved websites as a design library ChatGPT can read: colours, type, spacing, sections and Design.md files, measured from the sites themselves.

interface.longDescription:
Skiss is a design library for websites. Save a site you admire in one click and Skiss keeps it as it was that day: full-page screenshots plus its colours, type, spacing and page sections, read from the page's own CSS.

Connect Skiss to ChatGPT and ChatGPT works from your library instead of screenshots pasted into a chat. It can:

- Search your saved sites by text, tags, colour, tech and notes
- Read one site's colours, type, spacing, page sections and speed scores
- Get a site's Design.md: its design system in the standard DESIGN.md format, measured from its own elements
- Get a Design.md for a collection: one design direction measured across every site in it
- Find every hero, pricing table or footer you've saved
- Look up a colour and see which saved sites use it
- Export a palette as CSS, Tailwind, JSON or JS

Every value is measured from the sites themselves, never guessed. Every tool is read-only: ChatGPT can't tag, edit or delete anything, and you can switch it off or revoke it any time in Agent access in Skiss.

You need a Skiss account at app.skiss.co with some saved sites.
defaultPrompt: Search my Skiss library for dark, minimal sites
Get the Design.md for one of my saved sites and build a hero in its style
Find the pricing sections I've saved in Skiss

positive.description: Search the saved library. The reviewer account has several dark sites saved (for example linear.app and vercel.com).
positive.prompt: Search my Skiss library for dark sites
positive.expected_behavior: search_library is called with a query about dark sites. ChatGPT lists the matching saved sites by name and address (such as linear.app and vercel.com), with their main colours, and invents none.

positive.description: One site's Design.md. stripe.com is saved in the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Get the Design.md for stripe.com from my Skiss library
positive.expected_behavior: get_site_design_md is called with stripe.com. ChatGPT returns or summarises the DESIGN.md: YAML design tokens (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components) and sections such as Overview, Colors, Typography and Components, with the measured hex values.

positive.description: A collection's design direction. The reviewer account has a collection called Review collection with a Design.md already written.
positive.prompt: Use my Skiss collection called Review collection to plan a landing page
positive.expected_behavior: get_collection and generate_design_md are called with Review collection. ChatGPT plans a landing page from the collection's Design.md: it names the sites the collection holds and uses the measured colour roles, type and layout patterns from it rather than invented ones.

positive.description: Find saved sections. The reviewer account's saved home pages include hero sections.
positive.prompt: Find the hero sections I've saved in Skiss
positive.expected_behavior: find_sections is called with the hero kind. ChatGPT lists the saved hero sections by site and page (such as stripe.com and linear.app home pages).

positive.description: Export a palette. linear.app is saved in the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Export the palette from linear.app in my Skiss library as Tailwind
positive.expected_behavior: export_palette is called with linear.app and the tailwind format. ChatGPT returns a Tailwind theme block (@theme with --color-* variables) holding linear.app's measured hex colours.

negative.description: Off-topic request: Skiss is not called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Edmonton today?

negative.description: Delete request: no Skiss tool can delete, so no Skiss tool is called; ChatGPT says Skiss is read-only here and the site can be deleted in the Skiss app.
negative.prompt: Delete stripe.com from my Skiss library

negative.description: Save request: no Skiss tool can save a new site, so no Skiss tool is called; ChatGPT says sites are saved in Skiss itself or with the Skiss Chrome extension.
negative.prompt: Save nytimes.com to my Skiss library

review.commerce_description: Skiss has a Free plan and a paid Pro plan. Pro is bought on Skiss's own site (app.skiss.co) through Stripe checkout, outside ChatGPT. The plugin itself sells nothing and never shows plans, prices or upgrades inside ChatGPT; all its tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: First public version. Read-only access to your Skiss design library: search your saved sites, read their colours, type, spacing and sections, find saved sections, export palettes, and get Design.md files for a site or a collection.
